notes.title: First Major Update (September 2023)
notes.notes:
[b]UPDATES:[/b]

[i]Game Trailer:
[/i][previewyoutube=9URMT_Vp8t4;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]


[h3][u]New Features:[/u]
[/h3][list]
[*] 2 New scenery background.
[*] 2 Boss levels in thrill mode.
[*] There are now pets.
[*] Added environment bending 4th dimensional effects into thrill mode.
[*] You can now shuffle the playlist.
[*] Added in a time feature.
[/list]

[h3][u]In the store:[/u]
[/h3][list]
[*] 1 new plane.
[*] 2 new pieces of music have been added to both modes.
[/list]

[h3][u]In the achievements:[/u]
[/h3][list]
[*] 5 new achievements were added as (treasures).
[/list]

[h3][u]In the settings:[/u]
[/h3][list]
[*] Sound effects (can be adjusted).
[*] Shadow (can be adjusted).
[*] Shuffle music.
[*] Light (on/off).
[/list]

[h3][u]Improvements:[/u]
[/h3][list]
[*] The settings have been updated.
[*] The settings can now appear during the game.
[*] In the leaderboard, scrolling has been improved.
[*] The hitbox has been improved.
[/list]

[i]Thank you for checking the game out!
Have a wonderful flyingtastic day![/i]

notes.title: Solitary PaperPlane Release Date
notes.notes:
Attention all gamers! We are thrilled to announce that "Solitary PaperPlane" will be released on May 12th, 2023, just around the corner! Prepare to take to the skies and embark on an exciting journey with our game.
In "Solitary PaperPlane," you will experience the thrill of flying a paper airplane through challenging environments, avoiding obstacles, and collecting stars. With achievements, a leaderboard, and a store to purchase planes and music, "Solitary PaperPlane" offers a unique gaming experience that will keep you entertained for hours.
The game will be available for download on Friday, May 12th, 2023, at noon (EDT), so mark your calendars and get ready to play! We can't wait to share this exciting new game with you and hope you enjoy playing it as much as we enjoyed creating it.
Don't forget to share the news with your friends, family, and fellow gamers!

There will be a launch discount of 25%!


[i]As a game developer, we are always looking for feedback from our players. We want to know what you like about the game and what could be improved. Reviews are an essential way for us to receive feedback and improve the game for our players.
We welcome all positive or negative feedback, which helps us understand what players seek in a game. It also allows us to make changes and improvements to the game based on what our players want.[/i]
